subject.title: fix(agents): detect invalid UTF-8 in shell output accumulator with fatal decoder

question: Should malformed shell bytes become a core tool-result signal for agents, rather than an accumulator-only internal flag?
rationale: The PR adds a new binary-data contract but changes no presentation or executor consumer, so maintainers must choose whether detection should remain internal or be surfaced in the user/model-visible tool-result boundary.

options.title: Adopt lossless binary detection
options.body: Use parallel permissive and fatal streaming decoders, preserve all output bytes, and define the tool-result warning/metadata consumer.

options.title: Keep forgiving decoding
options.body: Retain current best-effort text output until there is an approved product contract for binary shell data.

recommendation.title: Adopt lossless binary detection
recommendation.body: Use parallel permissive and fatal streaming decoders, preserve all output bytes, and define the tool-result warning/metadata consumer.
